scope.partition_method: SHA-256(are-contextbench-v1:instance_id), ascending within source/language; first ceil(20%) reserved; no outcome-dependent selection

primary: Macro per-task final span F1 derived from unchanged native coverage/precision; derived statistic, not renamed native field
criteria: All 1136 pinned task identities accounted for in the final candidate evaluation; no subset-only clearance. Missing/failed tasks remain reported and cannot silently disappear.
Scorer and delivery exporter controls pass, all applicable language parsers verified, gold and private evaluation absent from model inputs.
On reserved confirmation, candidate minus matched baseline macro final-span F1 >= 0.05 at each window at the 96000-token primary tier; paired repository-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero.
At each primary-window confirmation comparison, candidate macro final-span coverage and precision and final-file coverage/precision each at least baseline; report exact deltas.
Equal cumulative input-plus-output caps, including model-assisted memory construction, failed calls and repeated presentation; no unknown usage in a clearance-claiming pair.
Both confirmation repetitions retain the gain direction; independently reconstructed final selections and native scores agree.
Report full task/language/source denominators and all three token-tier curves separately from custom post-delivery retention measures.

A retention benefit claim additionally requires confirmed prior delivery, actual displacement and independently verified subsequent evidence use; cumulative trajectory coverage alone cannot satisfy it.
threshold_origin: Project-specific preregistered engineering improvement target, not an official ContextBench pass mark. Defined before any model outcomes.
iteration_policy: Use development outcomes to create versioned hypotheses; keep thresholds fixed. Failed confirmation stays reported and becomes exposed evidence if used for tuning; resolve a fresh confirmation design before another clearance claim, never relabel exposed tasks as held-out.
run_critical_bindings_pending: exact GLM endpoint/model profile and admissible request construction
baseline/treatment implementations and predeclared task execution protocol
per-round selected development matrix and physical-call caps
native repository/task alignment and gold-free delivery trace integration
criterion-bound D08 adapter and confirmation statistical implementation
